object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Each search text has the stored letter case, so ignoring letter case is a gap.
object.description: In a repository of a parent document and a child document, search for child, for PARENT-1, and, after setting one object's type to Note, for Note. Expected: child finds the child document's object by its description; PARENT-1 finds that object first, with its ID among the matched fields; Note finds exactly the retyped object, with its type among the matched fields; each hit gives the document ID, object ID, snippet, score and matched fields.
